subject.title: [Bug]: Discord media uploads lose content-type and animated images lose frames

question: Should maintainers refresh/adopt the linked open PR, request contributor proof, or replace it with a fresh narrow current-main fix for this Discord media bug?
rationale: The issue is valid, but the open candidate PR has conflicts, proof gaps, and prior API/compatibility concerns that require maintainer judgment on the landing path rather than a new automated issue fix.

options.title: Refresh or replace the linked fix
options.body: Keep this issue canonical, update or replace the linked PR on current main, and require live Discord proof before closing the issue.

options.title: Wait for contributor proof
options.body: Leave the linked PR as the contributor-owned path and ask for redacted live Discord proof plus conflict resolution before review continues.

options.title: Close the linked PR and sponsor a new fix
options.body: If the current branch is no longer worth repairing, close it separately and sponsor a narrow replacement that credits the source work.

recommendation.title: Refresh or replace the linked fix
recommendation.body: Keep this issue canonical, update or replace the linked PR on current main, and require live Discord proof before closing the issue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest sampled history across the Discord send path, media loading, and plugin boundary involved in the fix shape.
